name: JobOps Pipeline
description: Work the jobsquare application queue: list pending roles, read eval reports, prepare tailored CV kits, and record applied/skipped status. Never fills or submits applications.

repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the jobsquare checkout.

chromePath.description: Chrome binary for jobops_fill (default the macOS app path).

chromeProfileDir.description: Dedicated Chrome user-data-dir for fills (default ~/.openclaw/jobops-chrome). ATS logins persist here.

cdpPort.description: DevTools port for the managed Chrome (default 18999).
